title: Credits Excused When Entitlement Is Restored After a Reduction
content:
**Decision table — credits excused in a restoration of Chapter 30, Chapter 35 or Chapter 1606 entitlement, Education Benefits (GI Bill and Dependents' Education).**

Credits excused in a restoration are the dropped credits VA treats as dropped on the last date of attendance. The credits dropped are the credits certified less the credits remaining on the restored reduction, never fewer than none, and the credits excused are never more than the credits dropped.

| VA accepted mitigating circumstances for the restored reduction on the student's evidence | The restored reduction is the first reported on the benefit | Credits excused |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Either | Every credit dropped |
| No | Yes | The credits dropped, up to the tier's exclusion of the first 6 credit hours a student ever drops, granted once |
| No | No — it follows an earlier reduction on the benefit | None |

"Follows an earlier reduction" means that another reduction is reported on the benefit besides the restored one.

**Precedent notes (hypothetical cases).**
- Evidence of military orders accepted; 12 credits certified, 3 remaining: 9 credits dropped, all 9 excused.
- No evidence accepted; first reduction on the benefit; 12 certified, 7 remaining: 5 dropped, 5 excused (below 6).
- No evidence accepted; first reduction; 12 certified, 6 remaining: 6 dropped, 6 excused (at 6).
- No evidence accepted; first reduction; 12 certified, 3 remaining: 9 dropped, 6 excused (above 6).
- No evidence accepted; a reduction already reported earlier on the benefit; 12 certified, 9 remaining: 3 dropped, none excused.
